scope: diagnose current RIDE versus original CPOP only; no production/default replacement or report; user decides the next candidate after findings
data_role: previous mainline data are now seen diagnostic data, not a new independent performance test
subset: first16 users, both events, in original ordered source;32 events per seed per scenario; no error-based selection
levels: oracle_reference_no_noise: remove meter noise, keep declared sigma0.05
oracle_reference_no_noise_no_post_rebound: change post-window power only to natural reference
oracle_reference_no_noise_relaxed_rebound: same input; only RIDE rebound ratio bound1 to1.5
reference_scope: Oracle reference and noiseless observations are evaluator-only diagnostics, never declared pre-notice available inputs
unchanged: original CPOP beta2logN and exact pruning
original RIDE BIC and solver except explicitly labelled bound/probe
outcomes: cumulative duration signed and absolute error
post_ablation_interpretation: removing rebound jointly removes timing and amplitude constraints; cannot attribute all improvement to one parameter
optimization_probe: first2 positive participating near_step events per seed, chosen by mechanism/order not error; oracle/noiseless/relaxed bound; analytic feasible M2 witness, and fixed n_starts minimum3 versus12; no source change or tuning search
positive_control: four predeclared exactly representable M1/M2 controls at1min, with/without delayed rebound/internal gap, clean/noisy, q1.5 and rebound within oldbound; only algorithm sanity, not a new performance sample
stop: one frozen diagnostic run; no repeated search until winning; retain failures; do not select final model or claim universal improvement
